# remotion-captioneer

> Word-perfect animated captions for Remotion — audio in, captioned MP4 out.
> MIT, TypeScript, 14 styles, 6 STT providers, zero-React rendering.

Docs: https://github.com/neutral-Stage/remotion-captioneer#readme
Live demo: https://neutral-stage.github.io/remotion-captioneer/
npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/remotion-captioneer

## Install

    npm install remotion-captioneer
    # CLI renderer (optional, for `captioneer render`):
    npm install -D @remotion/bundler@4 @remotion/renderer@4

## One-command pipeline (no React needed)

    npx captioneer autopilot clip.mp3 --preset tiktok --out clip-captioned.mp4
    # = transcribe → remove fillers → auto-emphasize → render MP4

Individual steps:

    npx captioneer process clip.mp3 --provider groq          # transcribe → captions.json
    npx captioneer tighten captions.json --in-place          # cut "um"/"uh", close gaps
    npx captioneer emphasize captions.json --in-place        # flag juicy words
    npx captioneer render captions.json --audio clip.mp3 --preset tiktok --out out.mp4
    npx captioneer render captions.json --video footage.mp4 --duration 12 --out out.mp4
    npx captioneer pacing captions.json --strict             # CPS readability gate (CI exit code)
    npx captioneer clean captions.json --mode mask --in-place
    npx captioneer translate captions.json -t es --glossary "Voxily:Voxily"
    npx captioneer export captions.json --format srt
    npx captioneer doctor                                    # environment health check

Other commands: init, batch, preview (web editor), demo (Remotion Studio), presets, providers, styles (create/validate/install/list).

## React API (inside Remotion compositions)

    import { AnimatedCaptions, applyPreset, markEmphasis } from "remotion-captioneer";

    const emphasized = markEmphasis(captions);

    <AnimatedCaptions
      captions={emphasized}
      {...applyPreset("tiktok")}     // 23 presets, 10 categories
      emphasisStyle="scale"          // "scale" | "color" | "glow"
      speakerHighlight               // per-speaker colors (diarized captions)
    />

Key props: style (14 built-ins), highlightColor, fontSize, fontFamily, position ("top"|"center"|"bottom"), maxWidth, wordsPerLine, useSmartWrap, textDirection ("rtl"), showSpeakerLabels, speakerColors, emphasisStyle, emphasisColor, animation (custom keyframes).

## Core functions

- processAudio / createProvider(name) — transcribe (providers: openai, groq, deepgram, assemblyai, elevenlabs, local whisper)
- markEmphasis(captions, { audio?: { volumeFrames } }) / detectEmphasis — flag stretched / ALL-CAPS / loud words (pure)
- filterFillers(captions, { remove, closeGaps, extraFillers }) — remove "um"/"uh"/"you know" (pure)
- filterProfanity(captions, { mode: "mask"|"remove"|"flag" }) — conservative matching (pure)
- analyzePacing(captions, { fastCps: 17, maxCps: 20 }) — CPS/WPM/readabilityScore (pure)
- snapCaptionsToBeats(captions, analysis.beats) — land word pops on beats (pure)
- analyzeAudio(path) → { beats, volumeFrames, ... } — beat/volume analysis
- translateCaptionData(captions, { targetLanguage, glossary }) — preserves word timing
- toSRT / toVTT / toASS / toTXT (from remotion-captioneer/node)
- validateAnimationSpec / sampleAnimation — custom keyframe animations
- All caption transforms are pure: input never mutated, untouched segments shared.

## Data formats

Captions JSON (CaptionData):

    { "segments": [ { "text": "...", "startMs": 0, "endMs": 1200, "speaker": "S1",
        "words": [ { "word": "hello", "startMs": 0, "endMs": 400, "confidence": 1, "emphasis": false } ] } ],
      "language": "en", "durationMs": 12000 }

Style package (marketplace JSON; `styles create` scaffolds it):

    { "schemaVersion": 1, "meta": { "id": "my-style", "name": "My Style", "description": "...", "version": "1.0.0" },
      "preset": { "name": "...", "description": "...", "style": "glow", "fontFamily": "Inter, sans-serif",
        "fontSize": 60, "fontColor": "rgba(255,255,255,0.4)", "highlightColor": "#00FF88", "position": "bottom",
        "animation": { "easing": "ease-out", "keyframes": [ { "at": 0, "scale": 0.4, "opacity": 0 } ] } } }

Animation keyframes: at (0–1 word progress, ascending), scale (0.05–10), opacity (0–1), yOffset (−500–500 px), color (#RRGGBB[AA] only). Max 32 keyframes. Pure data — no code execution.

## Environment

STT keys (pick one): OPENAI_API_KEY, GROQ_API_KEY, DEEPGRAM_API_KEY, ASSEMBLYAI_API_KEY, ELEVENLABS_API_KEY. No key → local whisper.cpp (auto-installed). Run `npx captioneer doctor` to verify setup.

## Agent tips

- Prefer the CLI over writing Remotion code when the user just wants a captioned video.
- Chain transforms in this order: process → tighten → clean → emphasize → (translate) → render.
- Every transform prints a summary; JSON-in/JSON-out commands accept `--in-place` or stdout.
- `pacing --strict` makes a good final quality gate before rendering.
